Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

(define (env-lookup name env)
  (let loop ((e env))
    (cond
      ((null? e) '__not-found__)
      ((eq? (caar e) name) (cdar e))
      (else (loop (cdr e))))))

(define (env-extend name value env)
  (cons (cons name value) env))

(define (env-set name value env)

    (cond

      ((eq? (caar e) name)

      (else (loop (cdr e))))))

(define (list-length lst)

    (if (null? l)

(define (procedure? x)
  (and (not (number? x))
       (not (string? x))
       (not (symbol? x))

       (not (eq? x #t))
       (not (eq? x #f))

    ((eq? name 'pair?) pair?)
    ((eq? name 'eq?) eq?)
    ((eq? name 'equal?) equal?)

;; Sentinel for "not found"
(define __evl_nf__ '__evl_nf__)

;; Global environment (mutable list containing one env list)
(define __evl_global_env__ (list '()))

;; === Environment helpers ===

(define (__evl_env_lookup name env)
  (let loop ((e env))
    (cond
      ((null? e) (cons #f #f))
      ((eq? (caar e) name) (cons #t (cdar e)))
      (else (loop (cdr e))))))

(define (__evl_env_extend name value env)
  (cons (cons name value) env))

(define (__evl_env_set name value env)
  (let loop ((e env))
    (cond
      ((null? e) #f)
      ((eq? (caar e) name)
       (set-cdr! (car e) value)
       env)
      (else (loop (cdr e))))))

;; === Utility ===

(define (__evl_list_length lst)
  (let loop ((l lst) (count 0))
    (if (null? l)
        count
        (loop (cdr l) (+ count 1)))))

(define (__evl_procedure? x)
  (and (not (number? x))
       (not (string? x))
       (not (symbol? x))
       (not (pair? x))
       (not (eq? x #t))
       (not (eq? x #f))
       (not (null? x))))

;; === Built-in value lookup ===

(define (__evl_builtin_value name)
  (cond
    ((eq? name 'display) display)
    ((eq? name 'newline) newline)
    ((eq? name 'read) read)
    ((eq? name 'getchr) getchr)
    ((eq? name 'putchr) putchr)
    ((eq? name 'chr) chr)
    ((eq? name 'fopen) fopen)
    ((eq? name 'fclose) fclose)
    ((eq? name 'fgetchr) fgetchr)
    ((eq? name 'fputchr) fputchr)
    ((eq? name 'fdisplay) fdisplay)
    ((eq? name 'fread) fread)
    ((eq? name 'cons) cons)
    ((eq? name 'car) car)
    ((eq? name 'cdr) cdr)
    ((eq? name 'null?) null?)
    ((eq? name 'pair?) pair?)
    ((eq? name 'eq?) eq?)
    ((eq? name 'equal?) equal?)
    ((eq? name 'not) not)
    ((eq? name 'and) and)
    ((eq? name 'or) or)
    ((eq? name 'symbol) symbol)
    ((eq? name 'symbol?) symbol?)
    ((eq? name 'string?) string?)
    ((eq? name 'number?) number?)
    ((eq? name 'set-car!) set-car!)
    ((eq? name 'set-cdr!) set-cdr!)
    ((eq? name 'else) else)
    ((eq? name '+) +)
    ((eq? name '-) -)
    ((eq? name '*) *)
    ((eq? name '/) /)
    ((eq? name '=) =)
    ((eq? name '<) <)
    ((eq? name '>) >)
    ((eq? name '<=) <=)

              (cdr (car bs))

import re

def check_balance(code):
    bal = 0
    lines = code.split('\n')
